basis: Delta-cell NET originates in endocrine pancreas (~60%) or bowel (~40%); direct somatostatin-mediated gallbladder dysfunction occurs in 30-79%.

decisions.hepatic: involved: sustained somatostatin-mediated gallbladder dysfunction represents direct loss of function; HPO frequency 30-79%.

basis: Germ-cell malignancy involving the pineal body, both a CNS structure and an endocrine gland.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the definition locates the tumor in the pineal body, an endocrine gland; endocrine symptoms are not required for a gland tumor.

basis: Developmental, skeletal and urethral defects define syndrome; hypospadias 30-79%, microtia 80-99%. Dental defects 30-79% omitted at cap; cardiac defects 5-29%.

decisions.renal: primary: hypospadias is a urethral malformation (30-79%); frequent genitourinary abnormalities are part of the syndrome's definition.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: dental abnormalities occur in 30-79%; omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of defining urethral defects and more frequent ear malformations.

basis: Defining anorectal and airway/lung defects 80-99%; vertebral/limb defects 30-79%. Renal agenesis 30-79%; cardiac defects 30-79% omitted at cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: cardiac defects qualify at 30-79%, but are omitted at the four-axis cap, prioritizing frequent airway/lung defects and irreversible renal agenesis.
decisions.pulmonary: primary: tracheoesophageal malformation is a defining criterion; tracheal stenosis and lung hypoplasia are annotated at 80-99%.
decisions.renal: involved: renal malformations are a major diagnostic criterion; agenesis and ectopic kidney each occur in 30-79%. Primary tier is capped at three.

basis: Peroxisomal metabolic disorder; developmental delay and rod-cone dystrophy each reported in 1/1. Hearing and hepatic dysfunction lack subtype frequency support.

decisions.otologic: none: sensorineural hearing loss is reported without frequency; involvement in at least 30% of this subtype is not established.

basis: Classic Zellweger metabolic disorder with defining cerebral and hepatic disease; jaundice and cataract each reported in 1/1. Skeletal abnormalities omitted at cap.

decisions.hepatic: primary: hepatic disease is a defining component of classic Zellweger syndrome; jaundice is reported in 1/1, with hepatomegaly also annotated.

basis: Inherited susceptibility specifies future glioma risk, without an existing tumor or established organ dysfunction.

decisions.neurologic: none: susceptibility alone establishes future risk, not an existing CNS tumor or neurologic damage.

basis: Skin and cranioskeletal defects define syndrome; lacrimal hypoplasia 5/5, visual and hearing impairment 80-99%. Dental defects 80-99% omitted at cap.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: dental agenesis/abnormalities qualify at 80-99%, but are omitted at the four-axis cap, prioritizing visual and hearing impairment.
decisions.otologic: involved: conductive hearing impairment is annotated at 80-99%, establishing common functional ear involvement.

basis: Pontocerebellar disease; cataract and optic atrophy each 4/8. Muscle atrophy and scoliosis each 7/8 reflect severe motor impairment rather than intrinsic muscle or bone disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: muscle atrophy and scoliosis (each 7/8) are secondary to severe neurologic motor impairment; direct myopathy or primary skeletal damage is not established.

basis: Severe inherited lymphocyte deficiency or dysfunction defines SCID; secondary organ infections are separate diseases.

decisions.haematologic: primary: SCID is a disease of lymphocytes, which are blood cells; the rules require the haematologic mechanism axis as well as infectious_immune.
